scope: HTTP error body lifecycle, transport read exceptions and bounded retries

findings.before: HTTP error bodies were not explicitly closed; read exceptions escaped structured handling; HTTP protocol read failures bypassed retries; nonfinite retry delays were accepted.
findings.after: HTTP status preserved with observable read/close failure diagnostics; response closure attempted before retry; HTTP protocol exceptions become network_error; finite retry delay required.

validation.real_cli: Injected IncompleteRead exhausts exactly three attempts, returns EXIT_TRANSIENT with network_error and creates no capture; synthetic key absent from output.
validation.test_correction: CLI regression initially expected EXIT_PROVIDER; corrected to existing EXIT_TRANSIENT contract for retryable errors. Production exit mapping unchanged.

review.mode: parent scoped implementation and regression review
